description: This file defines an abstract WebsocketService class for managing WebSocket connections, including connection handling, reconnection logic with exponential backoff, message processing, and error notifications within an Angular application.

classes.name: WebsocketService
classes.description: An abstract class providing WebSocket connection management, including connection lifecycle, message handling, reconnection with exponential backoff, and error notification logic.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to subscribe a WebSocket subscriber.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Abstract method to update a subscriber.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to unsubscribe a WebSocket subscriber.

methods.name: processOnMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to process incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: nextCmdId
methods.description: Generates and returns the next command ID.

methods.name: publishCommands
methods.description: Publishes queued commands over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: checkToClose
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket connection should be closed due to inactivity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state and optionally closes the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: tryOpenSocket
methods.description: Attempts to open a WebSocket connection, handling authentication.

methods.name: openSocket
methods.description: Opens a WebSocket connection with the provided token.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Handles WebSocket open event, manages state and subscriptions.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages and resets reconnection attempts.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles WebSocket close events, manages reconnection logic.

methods.name: showWsError
methods.description: Displays WebSocket error notifications based on error codes.
